title: Product Feature Callout Video Template | AIVideosUGC
description: Put one product feature in the spotlight with a callout video from a single photo. Show the detail in action, then add the exact label as text.
h1: Product Feature Callout Videos for One Clear Detail
lead: A key feature buried in a spec list rarely helps shoppers decide. Upload one product photo and make a callout video that shows the detail in action, so buyers see why it matters.
benefits_h2: Why make feature callout videos from one photo?

benefits.d: Show a pump press, clasp close, hinge opening or texture spread in close frame, so buyers see the feature working.
Give each feature its own short video and link it to the matching part of your product page, with no new shoots.
Use 9:16 in TikTok and Reels, 1:1 in feeds, or 16:9 on a product page, with clips at 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.
Type feature names, measurements and ingredients in your editor after download. The video carries no watermark.

steps_h2: Make a feature callout video in 3 steps
steps_lead: One product photo becomes a single-detail clip, with no presenter and no close-up shoot.

steps.d: Show the whole item and the part shoppers need to see in use.
Share one sentence about what moves, such as pressing a pump beside a sink.
Add the exact feature name, measurements and ingredients in your editor, then post in any size.

faq.q: Will the video render my feature label?
faq.a: Small text in a generated scene may be inaccurate. Add the feature name, ingredients and measurements in your editor after download.

faq.q: Can one video show several features?
faq.a: Make a separate video for each feature. One detail per clip keeps the action easy to follow.
No narration, music or captions are added. Add sound or written explanations in your editor.
Use a sharp, well-lit photo that shows the whole product and the feature clearly, without glare or tight crops.
Use 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, 1:1 for feeds and listings, or 16:9 for a product page.

faq.q: How much do the videos cost?
faq.a: Clips cost 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits at 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the charge is shown before you start.

visual.overview: A feature callout video puts one visible function at the center of the frame. Show the moving part in a single action, then add the exact feature name and measurements in your editor.

steps.sourceAlt: Plain white cleanser pump bottle photographed alone on a light background.
steps.sourceHint: Keep the full bottle and pump head visible.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. Beside a clean sink, a hand presses the white cleanser pump once and catches a small amount of foam on fingertips. Keep the bottle upright and fully visible. Close three-quarter framing with a gentle push-in. Even task light over the counter. End with the cleanser upright and foam visible on the fingertips. Sound: single pump and quiet room tone, no music.

cards.label: Cable Organizer Desk Demo
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a desk, an adult guides one loose charging cable into the organizer slot and leaves the other cables visible beside it. The adult looks at the tidier desk and gives a small, natural smile. Top-down close-up, slow push-in. Broad desk-side window light. End with one cable seated and the remaining cables loose at the desk edge. Sound: cable slide and desk ambience, no music.

cards.label: Microfiber Screen Cleanup Demo
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a home-office desk, an adult hand wipes dust from a blank dark tablet screen with a blue-gray microfiber cloth, leaving a clean strip beside the remaining dust. Keep the cloth and screen edge visible; show no face or readable screen text. Medium close framing with a slow sideward move. Soft window light. End on the clean strip and cloth together. Sound: soft cloth movement and quiet desk ambience; no music.

cards.label: Travel Mug Lid Detail
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a bright kitchen counter, one adult hand presses the locking tab on the stainless-steel travel mug lid once. Keep the hinge and latch in clear view and show no face. Tight overhead close-up with a gentle push-in. Soft window light. End with the tab closed and the full lid centered. Sound: one latch click and quiet kitchen room tone; no music.

cards.label: Food Container Seal Detail
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. On a kitchen counter, adult hands press the pale lid seal and close the visible latch on a clear glass food container. Keep the lid edge and latch in frame. Overhead close-up with a gentle push-in. Soft daylight. End with the sealed container centered. Sound: one latch click and quiet kitchen room tone; no music.

cards.label: Speaker Button Routine
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a home-office desk, one adult hand presses the round side button on the small charcoal desktop speaker once. Keep the button and speaker grille visible and show no face. Close eye-level desk framing with a short push-in. Soft window light. End with the button centered and the speaker steady. Sound: one soft button click and quiet room tone; no music.

cards.label: Jacket Fit Routine
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. An adult wearing the jacket turns toward the camera and says, “The sleeve length and front hem are visible.” Keep the full jacket front in frame. Natural fitting-room light, mirror-height medium shot. End facing camera with the jacket front centered from hem to collar. Sound: spoken line and quiet room tone; no music.

cards.label: Stain Remover Reaction
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. Beside a laundry sink, an adult sprays the stain remover once onto a marked shirt cuff and presses it with a plain cloth. Keep the bottle and cuff in view. Close handheld framing. Even task light over the counter. End with the bottle beside the treated cuff, both in clear view. Sound: one spray and cloth movement; no music.

cards.label: Protein Bar Taste Reaction
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a kitchen counter, an adult takes one bite of the protein bar, turns the cut side toward the lens and says, “You can see the oat and seed pieces.” Chest-up framing. Soft kitchen window light. End with the bar cut-side forward and its plain wrapper beside it. Sound: spoken line and one crisp bite; no music.
